name: BoolQ
intro: BoolQ是一个自然语言是非问答数据集。其问题是在无提示、无约束的自然场景下产生的，因此具有相当的挑战性。这些问题通常涉及复杂的非事实信息，需要模型具备强大的推理能力才能正确解答。
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1905.10044: BoolQ follows the Natural Questions pipeline with an added yes/no filter over anonymized Google search queries, keeps questions when a Wikipedia page appears in the first five results, asks annotators to judge question quality before seeing the page, select an answer-containing passage or mark it unanswerable, and label yes/no answers; it combines 13k newly gathered questions with 3k NQ yes/no questions into 16k examples, splits them into 9.4k train, 3.2k dev, and 3.2k test, audits 110 examples at 90% annotation accuracy, and evaluates yes/no prediction from question-passage pairs with accuracy against majority, human, entailment-transfer, and BERT+MultiNLI baselines.
intro_en: BoolQ is a natural language yes/no question answering dataset. Its questions are generated in unconstrained, natural scenarios without prompts, making it quite challenging. These questions often involve complex non-factual information, requiring models to have strong reasoning abilities to answer correctly.
